title: Paper White 2: the Following Pokémon's contextual dialogues, res/paperwhite2/following/dialogues.json
description: Texts the follower says in given places and conditions when the player talks to it, before the interactions' reactions are tried (member 0 of following/contextual-dialogues.narc of Pokeweb's runtime, "FWCD"), packed by tools/paperwhite2/following_assets.py as member 4 of the model table's archive (a/0/4/7), whose docstring has the format: ABI 1 with 20-byte rows, ABI 2 when a rule has a motion, and ABI 3 with 28-byte rows when a rule has tile bounds. The runtime rolls each rule in order and says the text of the first that matches and passes its chance. A rule without a condition matches any. The packed member and its one-member NARC must fit the runtime's 4 KB page. A string value is the name of a constant from generated/.

zone.description: The zone it is said in; not ZONE_BLACK_CITY, whose 0 stands for any

form.description: The follower's form, which needs a species

chance.description: The chance in percent that it is said when it matches; without it, 100

before_motion.description: The interactions' motion (interactions.json's motions, from 1) that the follower plays, with its cry, before the text

after_motion.description: The interactions' motion that it plays, with its cry, after the text

text.description: The text, at most 191 characters: \n starts a line, {nickname} is the Pokémon's nickname, {player} the player's name, {location} the zone, as "Zone N"

hp.description: The HP the Pokémon has left

status.description: The Pokémon's status condition (poison takes in bad poison, any_status any but healthy)

facing.description: The way the Pokémon faces to look at the player, which is where the player stands from it

tile_bounds.description: The tiles of the zone's matrix the player must stand in, inclusive: x goes east, y south; any of the four
